description: Module ↔ dashboard-core compatibility contract. dashboard-core is the hub: every known consumer module is declared here. The ContractTest reads each module's composer.json require (nreljed/dashboard-core caret-zero ^0.x range) and asserts the CURRENT core release (composer.json version) satisfies it — so a core minor bump must land simultaneously with the modules updating their ranges. Modules run the reverse guard in their own ModuleCoreCompatibilityTest (installed core must satisfy their declared constraint).
